subtopics.content: Definition, history, career opportunities, products, indigenous pottery, pioneer artists
subtopics.objective: Understand the history and scope of ceramics; identify utilitarian/decorative products (bricks, tiles, vases, bowls); study indigenous pottery traditions (Ntonso, Pankrono); recognize Ghanaian pioneer contemporary ceramic artists and their contributions.

subtopics.content: Clays, glazes, colouring oxides, stains, and material preparation
subtopics.objective: Define clay formation and types (primary/kaolin, secondary/ball clay, earthenware, stoneware); test for plasticity, shrinkage, and firing temperatures; prepare plastic and rough clay bodies; study glazes, stains, and colouring oxides.

subtopics.content: Hand tools, major equipment, design and construction of tools
subtopics.objective: Identify, use, and maintain modeling tools, calipers, kidneys, sponges, and cutting wires; understand operation/maintenance of kilns, potter's wheels, blungers, pug mills, ball mills, and spray booths; construct basic ceramic tools and equipment.

subtopics.content: Drawing/designing, hand building, wheel work, casting, pressing, extrusion
subtopics.objective: Develop ideas through sketching, dimensioning, and CAD; master hand-building methods (pinching, coiling, slabbing); perform wheel work (throwing, turning); execute casting, pressing, and extrusion forming processes.

subtopics.content: Decorative processes, drying, firing types, glazing techniques and defects
subtopics.objective: Apply decorative techniques (stamping, inlaying, incision, sgraffito, slip trailing, sprigging); execute open firing, bisque firing, and glost firing; prepare and apply glazes, and identify/correct glazing defects.

subtopics.content: Site finding, financing, branding, enterprise management, costing, exhibitions
subtopics.objective: Evaluate factors for establishing an enterprise (financing, licensing, quality control); manage pricing, packaging, and marketing; plan and organize exhibitions; address environmental sustainability (afforestation, energy conservation, land reclamation).

topics.title: Professional Practices, Ethics, Museums and Galleries

subtopics.content: Healthy studio practices, portfolio, business plan, museum functions and structure
subtopics.objective: Maintain safe studio habits; construct portfolios, business cards, and business plans; define museum history, socio-economic importance, administrative structure, and cultural functions.
